name: FFS_RESOURCE_WORK_SKILL
description: Contains work skills, work skill groups, and capacity categories configured on the resource level.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the resource work skill to resource assignment record.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a resource to which a work skill is assigned.

columns.name: WORK_SKILL_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a work skill which is assigned to a resource.

columns.name: RATIO
columns.description: Indicates ratio of assigned work skill to a resource in range of 1 to 100. Means level of proficiency for this work skill for this resource.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Indicates date since when the work skill assignment to a resource is active.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Indicates date until which the work skill assignment to a resource is active.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
